title: Explainability Signal Atlas — interactive error attribution and retry guidance
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Overview:
Design an interactive "Explainability Signal Atlas" panel inside the Redwood Console that helps engineers triage failed requests by attributing failures to high-level causal signals (model mismatch, input sanitation, infra timeout, quota rejection, KV cache miss, tokenization error) and surface lowest-effort remediation paths (retry with modified backoff, switch to compatible model variant, sanitize payload, or suggest canary rollback).

Goals:
- Provide a single-pane view that maps request failures to an evidence-backed taxonomy instead of raw error strings.
- Make it actionable: each attribution should include an estimated confidence, token-level excerpts (when safe), suggested retry action with estimated cost/latency delta, and a one-click sandbox retry button.
- Connect to rollouts and capacity: show whether the error spike correlates with specific model versions, dedicated capacity pools, or region fallbacks.
- Preserve privacy: automatically redact PII from displayed payloads and surface sanitized previews with a clear audit trail.
- Support handoff: allow exporting selected evidence to a GitHub issue or incident runbook with stack traces and timestamps.

Scope (MVP):
- Atlas panel docked in Request Details and available from Failed Requests list.
- Taxonomy engine wireframe: categories and confidence bar; clickable evidence buckets.
- Token-level highlights for up to 3 candidate signals per request (redacted by default).
- Retry suggestions: three ranked actions with estimated cost delta and latency expectation.
- Correlation strip: lightweight band showing model variant, region, and capacity tier over a 1h window.

Out of scope for MVP:
- Automated rollback orchestration (we only surface risk score and link to rollout controls).
- Full-fidelity payload replay across environments (blocked by PII compliance).

Acceptance criteria:
- Design mockups in Figma for Atlas panel (docked + expanded modal) with accessible color contrast and keyboard flows.
- Prototype that demonstrates: selecting an evidence bucket, toggling redaction, and triggering a sandbox retry flow (simulated response).
- Usability test notes from at least 3 engineers confirming the taxonomy and retry suggestions are intelligible and useful.
- Export button creates a prefilled GitHub issue template containing the selected evidence and suggested remediation.

Design constraints and trade-offs:
- Must balance visibility vs. privacy: default redaction with an unobtrusive control to reveal raw payloads for authorized users only.
- Confidence estimates are advisory; we should avoid deterministic phrasing that asserts causality.
- Because token-level accents are expensive to index, initial UX will show token snippets sampled at failure time; later work can increase coverage.

Accessibility notes:
- All interactive elements follow 4.5:1 contrast minimum.
- Provide ARIA labels for evidence buckets and retry suggestions.

Deliverables:
- Figma frames + interactive prototype (links below).
- PRD section to Confluence describing taxonomy and backend signals needed.
- Design handoff package (tokens, component specs, CSS variables).

Implementation assumptions for engineering:
- Backend will return: inferred_taxonomy: [{category, confidence, evidence_snippets}], correlated_rollout_metadata: {model_variant, pool_id, region, window_counts}, and a sanitized_preview with redaction markers.
- Sandbox retry API exists at /internal/requests/:id/sandbox-retry (feature-flagged).

2025-02-19 — Miguel Santos (Eng): Backend will supply taxonomy scores from the diagnostic pipeline but token snippets need an opt-in flag due to retention policy. Suggested 'redactionLevel' in response. Logged ENG-25912 as dependency.
2025-02-21 — PM review (Nina Park): Please add cost delta estimates for each suggested retry (P50 token cost) and a small badge if action changes model variant. Added label 'cost-visibility'.

2025-02-24 — Design review: Session with Accessibility and Security. Security requires default redaction + audit log. Accessibility requested keyboard-first flows and focus states for evidence buckets. Updated prototype accordingly.

2025-02-26 — Liam O'Connor: Built click-path prototype demonstrating evidence selection and sandbox retry (simulated). Usability study scheduled with three backend engineers next week. Prototype link in attachments.

2025-02-28 — Review feedback from Solutions Eng (Priya Desai): Wanted better rollout correlation viz — propose small sparkline per model variant and a 'canary exposure' indicator. Added to next iteration.
